evidence.detail: Launcher creates rs/gui/O and sets client property 'substancelaf.internal.titlePane.extraComponentKind' to Substance ExtraComponentKind.TRAILING before inserting it into the live Substance title pane.
Launcher adds its small 23x22 side-panel control button to this panel; the panel contains no gameplay content or unrelated state.
The panel installs rs/gui/P as its sole custom LayoutManager2, forming one dedicated title-bar-controls component family.

candidates.note: Exact-v308 trailing launcher title-pane control panel.

evidence.detail: LauncherTitleBarControlsPanel constructs this LayoutManager2 in its constructor and no other component owns it.
preferred/minimum/maximum width is componentCount*27 with height 23; layoutContainer places children left-to-right in 23-pixel slots with 4-pixel leading spacing and vertical centering.

candidates.note: Exact-v308 layout manager for the trailing launcher title-bar controls panel.

evidence.detail: Launcher wraps the Substance title-pane component's existing LayoutManager with this class, retaining the original manager and the title-pane JComponent.

layoutContainer first delegates normal layout, then measures LauncherTitleBarControlsPanel preferred width and sets that panel's bounds at titlePaneWidth - 75 - controlsWidth, y=0, full title-pane height.
The only extra component it repositions is the same trailing rs/gui/O panel explicitly registered by Launcher as the Substance title-pane trailing component.

candidates.note: Exact-v308 layout wrapper that positions the launcher trailing title-bar controls after normal Substance title-pane layout.
